title: Bound-evidence check does not admit a registered run's stage record ("source identity differs or is unavailable") although the run's sourceIds equal the judged commit
outcome: Bound-evidence check does not admit a registered run's stage record ("source identity differs or is unavailable") although the run's sourceIds equal the judged commit
acceptance: The cause is identified from source and the w-349e evaluation's evidence: why the record of test-69ddade9 was not admitted although its sourceIds equal the judged commit.

A registered committed-input run whose sourceIds equal the judged revision is admitted as citable evidence for a test-bound criterion, covered by a behaviour test with a git_delta-format source_id; a run on a different input is still refused.
